resources.string: ChefMate keeps every part of home cooking in one place — the recipes you love, the meals you’re planning, and the groceries you need to buy. This quick tour walks through the essentials so you can hit the ground running.

Found a recipe while browsing in Safari, Chrome, or any app? Tap the share button and choose ChefMate. The recipe’s photo, ingredients, and steps come straight into your collection — no copying and pasting.

Found a recipe out on the web? Copy its address from your browser’s address bar and paste it into ChefMate. It pulls in the photo, ingredients, and steps automatically — no copying and pasting the page.

Prefer to stay in the app? Open the built-in browser to search the web for recipes. When you land on one you like, tap Download and ChefMate saves the ingredients, steps, and photo directly to your account.
Open any recipe and tap the cart in the toolbar to send its ingredients straight to a grocery list. ChefMate combines duplicates so you never buy the same thing twice.
Just ask Siri. Say “Add eggs to my ChefMate grocery list” and it lands on your list — no need to open the app, even when your hands are full.
Just ask Gemini. Say “Add eggs and milk to my ChefMate grocery list” and they land on your list — no need to open the app, even when your hands are full.
Add it to your meal plan
Tap the calendar in the recipe toolbar to drop a recipe onto any day of the week. Map out breakfast, lunch, and dinner so there’s never a question of what’s for dinner.
When you’re ready to cook, tap Start Cooking in the toolbar for a distraction-free, step-by-step view. Text stays large and your screen won’t dim, so you can keep both hands on the food.
Group your recipes into as many books as you like — weeknight dinners, holiday baking, family favorites. Share a book with friends and family so everyone can cook from the same collection.
Keep more than one grocery list — one for the week, one for a party, one for the hardware run. Share a list with family or roommates and everyone’s changes stay in sync as you shop.
Plan, shop, and cook as a family

Start a family from Manage Family in the More tab and invite the people you cook with. Plan meals together on a family meal plan, shop from the same family grocery lists, and collect everyone’s favorites in family recipe books — changes show up for the whole family.

That’s the whole tour. Save your favorite recipes, plan out your week, and build grocery lists that keep you organized — all from one app. Jump in whenever you’re ready; you can revisit these features any time from the app.
